searchText: I’ve always wondered why big cex exchanges aren’t forced to pay yakuza like protection fees to proposers/builders to avoid censorship. Or even prioritization when each pays the same gas and tip but only part of mempool can be included. PBS and Danksharding (which doubles down on builder centralization) still appear to have general consensus, moving full steam ahead. I don't see a lot of discussion on these downsides, or is it taking place elsewhere? You can voice your concerns here: <https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/sharding-design-with-tight-beacon-and-shard-block-integration-danksharding/8291>
